I saved and finished `candidate_01`, which assigns a use to all 8 rooms and leaves the geometry unchanged. Every room polygon, level, opening, host and connection is as in the seed. The source geometry checks pass, but that only shows internal consistency. I did not verify drawing fidelity.

The drawing has no text labels, so every use is inferred from furniture and layout. Each is recorded with the pixel region it came from.

| Room | Use | What the drawing shows |
|---|---|---|
| S01 | office | North room with an L-shaped desk group |
| S02 | enclosed office | Small room with a long desk and two chairs |
| S06 | enclosed office | Two workstations with chairs |
| S03 | corridor | Narrow central strip with doors to the neighbouring rooms, widening to the south-east |
| S04 | storage | Small room holding only cabinet or shelf units; it could equally be an archive or office |
| S05 | conference/meeting/multipurpose | Two table-and-four-chair groups; dining is also possible |
| S07 | conference/meeting/multipurpose | Large oval table with ten chairs |
| S08 | enclosed office | Single desk with two chairs |

The revision also replaced the old note saying all room roles were unknown. The unrelated caveats stay in the notes: the assumed 2.1 m door heights, no upper floors or stairs, unknown door state, and calibration that was supplied but not independently checked.

- **Not checked:** I looked only at the floor plan (`1f_view.png`). I did not open the four elevation views, so none of the 21 openings has its height checked against an elevation.
- **Not checked:** I ran no sampled checks of whether points fall in the same or separate spaces.
- **Uncertain:** S04 and S05 are the least certain uses.
